_comment: The smoke universe is PINNED, not sampled. A smoke test whose corpus moves
cannot fail reproducibly, so this file is committed and these task names
are part of the test. Replace them with faults from your own frozen pool
the first time you run `caster freeze`, then commit the change AND the
`smoke/expected.json` that `caster smoke` writes beside it — without the
expectations committed, smoke is a liveness check, not a regression test.
EVERY arm, deliberately. An arm missing from here is an arm whose first
breakage is found by a grid, not by a seconds-long CI gate.
Rows go under data/<run>/smoke/, which `caster merge`'s glob cannot match.
